documents.text:
IN THE COURT OF THE CIVIL JUDGE, DELHI
Case No. 123/2024
Notice issued on 12 January 2025.
The defendant must appear on 05/02/2025 at 10:30 AM.
Last date to file reply: within 30 days of receipt.

FIRST INFORMATION REPORT
Police Station: Connaught Place, New Delhi
FIR No. 45/2025
Date of incident: 2 March 2025
Accused arrested on 03/03/2025 and produced before the magistrate within 24 hours.
Sections: 302 and 307 of the Indian Penal Code.

RENT AGREEMENT
This agreement is made on 1 April 2025 between the landlord and the tenant.
Monthly rent is Rs. 15,000. Security deposit is Rs. 30,000.
The tenant must give 30 days notice before vacating.
Rent for May is due on 5th day of May 2025.

SALE DEED
This sale deed is executed on 15 May 2024 between the seller and the buyer.
The property is located at Plot No. 12, Sector 5.
The sale deed was registered with the Sub-Registrar on 20 May 2024.

LEGAL NOTICE
Notice is hereby given on 10 June 2025 to the tenant to pay the outstanding rent.
You are required to reply within 15 days of receiving this notice.
Failing which, legal proceedings will be initiated.

न्यायालय, दिल्ली
नोटिस जारी की तारीख: 12 जनवरी 2025
अगली सुनवाई: 05/02/2025
जवाब देने की अंतिम तिथि: 30 दिनों के भीतर

சட்ட அறிவிப்பு
தேதி: 12 ஜனவரி 2025
பதில் அளிக்க 15 நாட்கள்

చట్టపరమైన నోటీసు
తేదీ: 12 జనవరి 2025
సమాధానం ఇవ్వడానికి 15 రోజులు

CONSUMER COMPLAINT
The complainant purchased a refrigerator on 5 July 2025.
The product developed a defect on 20 July 2025.
A complaint was filed before the District Consumer Commission on 1 August 2025.

APPLICATION FOR MAINTENANCE
The wife filed an application for maintenance on 8 August 2025.
The next hearing is on 20/09/2025.
The husband must file a reply within 15 days.
